note: Page-time budgets in milliseconds, as the median on the seeded four-times project (make perf-budget). The target is 300 ms per page and 100 ms for the frame share. A page over its target carries a temporary budget: its measured median plus about 40% for the noise of a loaded machine, rounded up to 100 ms. Each fix task lowers the budgets of the pages it fixes, in this file.
